title: Don't try to resolve host path if copying from container to stdout
body:
### Issue Description

- `podman cp <ctr>:<path> -` fails on the Windows client:
  ```
  Error: "/dev/stdout" could not be found on the host: no such file or directory
  ```
- copying to a host directory works, only copying to stdout fails
- issue seems to be very similar to #25472  but in the opposite direction (container -> stdout instead of stdin -> container)

### Steps to reproduce the issue

1. On Windows, prepare a container (tested on latest Podman 6.2.0)
2. Try to cp a file to stdout:
   ```
   cmd /c "podman cp cptest:/etc/hostname - > out.tar"
   ```

- result: `Error: "/dev/stdout" could not be found on the host: no such file or directory`
- expected: a tar archive on stdout

<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

### Fix

Similar to #25485 skip calling `copy.ResolveHostPath` when copying to stdout because its result is never used in this case. 

### Tests

- extended e2e tests with a case for copying to stdout
- tested locally on Windows and Linux and the tar is streamed correctly after the fix, with no errors
